examples.text: Kann es ein, dass die USA einem Staat trotz harter politischer Konflikte mit dessen Regierung einen auf den Schutz unschuldiger Zivilisten zielenden Tipp geben? Nach der Logik Putins ist das unmöglich. So etwas wie eine über alle politischen Streitigkeiten erhabene Menschlichkeit gibt es nicht im Denken dieses Machthabers.
examples.translation: Est-il possible que les Etats-Unis donnent une astuce à un Etat visant à protéger des civils innocents, malgré des conflits politiques durs avec son gouvernement ? Selon la logique de Poutine, c'est impossible. Il n'y a rien de tel qu'une humanité au-dessus de toutes les querelles politiques dans la pensée de ce dirigeant.

examples.text: In den USA, Großbritannien und Pakistan wurden in Solaranlagen benötigte Wechselrichter von Deye deaktiviert – wohl aufgrund juristischer Streitigkeiten.
examples.translation: Aux États-Unis, en Grande-Bretagne et au Pakistan, des onduleurs Deye nécessaires dans des installations solaires ont été désactivés, probablement en raison de litiges juridiques.

translations.source_sense_description: anhaltende Auseinandersetzung zwischen Personen oder Institutionen

glosses: A clash or disagreement, often violent, between two or more opposing groups or individuals.

examples.text: The conflict between the government and the rebels began three years ago.

One particularly damaging, but often ignored, effect of conflict on education is the proliferation of attacks on schools[…]as children, teachers or school buildings become the targets of attacks. Parents fear sending their children to school. Girls are particularly vulnerable to sexual violence.

glosses: An incompatibility, as of two things that cannot be simultaneously fulfilled.

examples.text: I wanted to attend the meeting but there's a conflict in my schedule that day.

glosses: To be at odds (with); to disagree or be incompatible

examples.text: [T. E.] Lawrence said that in the end he felt himself to be fighting not for the imperial British but for the rebellious Arabs. All too often he conflicted with British bureaucratic fustiness.

glosses: To overlap (with), as in a schedule.

examples.text: Your conference call conflicts with my older one: please reschedule.
It appears that our schedules conflict.

translations.source_sense_description: anhaltende Auseinandersetzung zwischen Personen oder Institutionen

glosses: Argument, contest, debate, strife, struggle.
A point maintained in an argument, or a line of argument taken in its support; the subject matter of discussion of strife; a position taken or contended for.

examples.text: It is my contention that state lotteries are taxes on stupid people.

glosses: Competition by parts of a system or its users for a limited resource.

translations.source_sense_description: anhaltende Auseinandersetzung zwischen Personen oder Institutionen

glosses: An argument or disagreement, a failure to agree.

examples.text: A "who-does-what" labour dispute at Swindon works during April led to a stoppage of work on the construction of the new 0-6-0 Type 1 diesel-hydraulic locomotives of the D9500 series and work had not been resumed as we closed for press.

glosses: Verbal controversy or disagreement; altercation; debate.

examples.text: Addicted more / To contemplation and profound dispute.

glosses: to contend in argument; to argue against something maintained, upheld, or claimed, by another.

examples.text: "Now, though thy thoughts are green and tender, as becometh one so young, yet are they those of a thinking brain, and in truth thou dost bring back to my mind certain of those old philosophers with whom in days bygone I have disputed at Athens, and at Becca in Arabia, for thou hast the same crabbed air and dusty look, as though thou hadst passed thy days in reading ill-writ Greek, and been stained dark with the grime of manuscripts."

glosses: to make a subject of disputation; to argue pro and con; to discuss

examples.text: Some residents disputed the proposal, saying it was based more on emotion than fact.

glosses: to oppose by argument or assertion; to controvert; to express dissent or opposition to; to call in question; to deny the truth or validity of

glosses: to strive or contend about; to contest

glosses: to struggle against; to resist

examples.text: Dispute it [grief] like a man.
